request.description: Creates an organization with full profile, subscription, owner identity, workspace, and membership in a single ACID transaction. A cryptographic setup token is generated and an invitation email is dispatched to the owner.
Transfers organization ownership to a new identity. If the new owner does not exist, their identity is provisioned and a setup token is generated. The previous owner is demoted to admin.
Regenerates and resends a 6-character verification setup code to the active owner of the target organization.
